dev: mkdir -p .dev-tmux && env -u TMUX TMUX_TMPDIR="$PWD/.dev-tmux" DB_PATH="$PWD/.dev.db" npm run dev
test: npm run typecheck && npx vitest run <the test files you touched>
notes: Run targeted tests (`npx vitest run path/to/x.test.ts`) while you work; the full suite loads the machine.
The dev command above keeps the dev instance on its own port, database and tmux server: never run one against the real database or tmux.
Never stop or restart the AgentOS server you are running under; it ends your own session.
